name: Operational Review
summary: Logical management arc for reviewing how an operation is running: the situation, the complication that threatens it, the resolution, and the roadmap and action plan that deliver it. Built for operations, program and service reviews where the audience needs a decision and a plan, not a story.

beats.name: Headline
beats.description: Open with the operation under review and the one-sentence conclusion of the whole review, so the audience knows where it is going before the detail starts.

beats.name: Situation
beats.description: Describe how the operation runs today with the few metrics that define it: volume, quality, cost, time. Stick to facts the room will agree with.

beats.name: Complication
beats.description: Name what has changed or is at risk: the trend, constraint or failure that makes the current way of running unsustainable. Quantify the cost of doing nothing.

beats.name: Root Causes
beats.description: Explain why the complication is happening. Separate causes the team controls from those it does not, and point to the evidence for each.

beats.name: Resolution
beats.description: Recommend the change that resolves the complication, with the expected effect on the metrics from the situation slide. One recommendation, stated plainly.

beats.name: Roadmap
beats.description: Lay out the phases that deliver the resolution, with what each phase changes and the milestone that marks it done.

beats.name: Action Plan
beats.description: List the immediate actions with an owner and a due date for each, plus the risks to watch. This is the slide people will screenshot.

beats.name: Decision
beats.description: Close with the decision or support you need from this audience today, and what happens next once you have it.
